## Freelance Services Offered
1. **Web Developer & Web Developer Freelancer**:
   - Custom web engineering, responsive business websites, single page websites, and scalable web platforms.
   - Frontend and backend architecture, fast page load speeds, and conversion-optimized UI/UX design.
   - Tech stacks: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, static site generation, responsive layouts, API integrations.
2. **Digital Marketing Freelancer**:
   - End-to-end digital marketing campaigns: Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram).
   - High-ROI lead generation, full-funnel customer acquisition, conversion tracking, and analytics setup.
   - Digital growth strategy, brand positioning, and performance marketing for startups and growing enterprises.
3. **SEO, AEO & GEO Freelancer**:
   - **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: High-intent keyword targeting, technical on-page/off-page SEO, schema markup, and speed audits.
   - **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Structuring entity graphs (`JSON-LD @graph`) and brand citations so that AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) cite and recommend your business.
   - **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Formatting concise definitional QA blocks for voice search and AI search overviews.
4. **AI & Workflow Automation**:
   - Automated CRM data pipelines, lead routing, automated notification workflows, and smart chatbot triggers.
